definition: Pinned-head local git trees. Nested: studied basename outside the predefined root locations. Rules: tracked files under .cursor/rules, .claude/rules, .github/instructions or .windsurf/rules. Imports: @path tokens in shipped root context text resolving to tracked .md/.mdx/.txt/.rst/.adoc files relative to that root file. Import candidates are syntactic, not human-confirmed directives; other import syntaxes are unmeasured.
